summary: Added the password rules to the sign-up page: the rule list renders under the password field as hint text, and on submit every unmet rule produces its own error line (shown together in one alert list) before the existing match/duplicate-email checks run. Rules and the validator are exported from `Signup.jsx` so they stay in one place.
blockers: Not applied -- Server-side enforcement of the same password rules: belongs to the separate backend repository
conventions: Sign-up passwords must be >= 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one non-alphanumeric special character
Password rule failures are reported per-rule on submit, not as a single combined message

visual_check.evidence: The signup page shows the five password rules (at least 8 characters, one uppercase, one lowercase, one number, one special character) as a bulleted list directly under the Password field.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here: Signup.jsx persists accounts entirely client-side via src/store.js, which reads/writes localStorage key 'acme-users' (keyed by lowercased, trimmed email) and sessionStorage key 'acme-current'. src/style.css contains only styling and no contract. Client-side routes referenced are '/login' (via navigate and Link).
